description: Classificazione didattica di ricevute hotel e ristoranti

hotel_receipt.description: Hotel bills and folios for a stay, with room charges, arrival and departure dates, lodging taxes and payments. May include restaurant charges within the hotel bill.

restaurant_receipt.description: Standalone restaurant or cafe receipts for meals and drinks, with food items, taxes, tips and totals. Not a hotel stay or folio.

other.description: Documents that are neither hotel bills nor standalone restaurant receipts, such as letters, contracts or bank statements.
